mentions.name: Chaffiti
mentions.description: Chaffiti is a conversation layer for the internet that lets any webpage have its own comment section, aiming to reduce the need to reference multiple services for context on things like potential employers, service providers, property managers, and real estate listings. It is currently in iOS and macOS alpha testing.
mentions.problem: People need to reference multiple services to get context on whatever they want information on, such as potential employers, service providers, property managers, or real estate listings.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m tinkering with adding a conversation layer to the internet whereby any webpage can have a comment section. Ideally this would minimize the need to reference multiple services to get context on whatever you want information on (think potential employer or service provider, property manager, real estate listing, etc…)
mentions.author: mrdazm
